descriptions.d25l_expand_text_properties_8029eb3c: Copies a string byte by byte through the global output pointer at 0x804b0e6c. A /* marker starts a name, read into a 128-byte buffer up to the closing */; if the property lookup 0x800fc1b0 finds that name, its text is expanded recursively. The last byte before the terminator is copied and the held property is released on return.
